title: Footima addat tan tibbale xongolo
intro: Dooqa qagaaqagitak sugte sabhalal le diini footimaamih addat xer waktih addat, ugutteh idaltuh yan rooci sanat maca baadal yeybeleeleqeh sugem akke waytam. ta muuci, liggidittet naharal kee fooca fan tan bohoy quukak, cankah xaaqo sinni Rabbih fanah yuduureh. Tamah katayak sugtem, kulli ginoh qammalsimak sugteh tan diini gacsa kinnim—qangarah addat tan seeco gacsa numih racmatta kinnim tamixxige.
clues: Anu inni Rabbih cankah seeceeh, kay qibaadah inni elle acee footima fan gexe.
Anu yi Rabbih oggoleh too anu meysiteh too yok lakal yamaate marah, bohoy yi ummattah miracsenta inki adda anu gexek.
Idalti yoo gufteh sugte- yi lafoofi qaku luk sugteeh, qado dagor moyyal yok fiddinowteh sugte.
Yi barra tet manol inkih malay luk sugte, uxih anu uxih yi Rabbi essereh kay xaquk naggaari yoh yaceem.
Anu asta essereeh, yi Rabbi sidiica bar num lih yaabam yoo waasak, anu xagar digga luk suge wak, yoh gacsa.
Anu xagana culeh suge baxi migaq kaak Yahya, migaq yi Rabbi yeybeleeleqeh suge ahak dumal numuh yomcowweh masuginna.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Xaylo sinni barra lih idaltuh naggaarinah dooqa abaanama
Buxâ maraay, gadda kee qaafiyat wayti coolaysitaanam
trial.answer: Xaylo sinni barra lih idaltuh naggaarinah dooqa abaanama

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Kaxxam idaltuuy, assakat le gurral muggaaqime baxi yomcowwe
Sabrik lakal buxâ maraay, gadda kee qaafiyat fan yuduureh.
Firqawni kee kay qande baddi addat culte.
outcome.answer: Kaxxam idaltuuy, assakat le gurral muggaaqime baxi yomcowwe

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
